review_scope.scope_note: These statements concern this independent Round5 selection review. Only the explicitly requested review receipt is written; no source or experimental artifact was modified.

design_findings.finding: Within each exact-mixture or moment family, legacy/full-range selectors share the component pair, fitted-prior preparation, training/development rows and zero-context query information. Each evaluates 21 candidates. Range and spacing change jointly; nested candidate sets and monotonic improvement are not assumed.

Frozen anchor, legacy replay Gaussian, current-only Gaussian interpolation, exact mixture, separately fitted moment family and same-weight moment projection are present. Gaussian endpoint and cross-family differences remain descriptive, with unequal architecture/arithmetic budgets disclosed.

Exactly two primary full-range-minus-legacy density-NLL contrasts, averaging complete query scores over six fixed drift windows. Three correlated horizons stay inside each query score. The inherited interval resamples training-seed clusters and whole queries within each fixed window. Per-comparison alpha .025 is the nominal two-comparison Bonferroni family.

Old-development mean paired NLL increase plus 1.645 paired SE <= .02 is explicitly a selection heuristic. Primary upper endpoint < 0 is sign evidence only. The .005 anchor-relative efficacy margin and old/calibration conditions are separate empirical/descriptive profile gates; worst individual seed-window deterioration is separately reported.

Prediction uses public query histories only. Targets are used for training, development selection or post-freeze scoring. Query IDs, hidden law metadata and future labels do not enter the conditional-law predictor. Registration/smoke/unit namespaces are distinct; the smoke profile cannot address registered confirmation identities.

Preparation records all sources and numerical environment; freeze binds complete prepared artifacts and reviewed registration. Confirmation verifies them before constructing confirmation arrays. Local identity binding is explicitly distinguished from remote publication and durable storage.

initial_blockers_and_closures.initial_finding: The original standalone summarize entry checked registration/score hashes but did not bind the frozen sources, prepared model, numerical environment or raw confirmation identities.
initial_blockers_and_closures.closure: summarize now calls verify_confirmation, which calls verify_prepared against the exact freeze; verifies start/index freeze and environment identities; checks complete raw/score/scope inventory, per-scope checkpoint binding, raw seeds/IDs/digests, score roster/shapes/finiteness, targets/labels and within-query density averaging. Results bind index and freeze hashes.

initial_blockers_and_closures.initial_finding: Effective numerical environment was not recorded or checked across preparation, freeze, confirmation and recovery summary.
initial_blockers_and_closures.closure: environment_snapshot records Python implementation/version/executable, NumPy/SciPy versions and build configurations, platform/machine and numerical-thread environment. Matching identity is required at preparation completion, freeze, confirmation and recovery.

other_findings_and_closures.finding: Original component-fit receipts lacked per-fit parent CPU; outer summary verification/bootstrap had no timer.
other_findings_and_closures.closure: New adapt wrapper records complete component-call wall and parent CPU, retaining nested inherited timing. Summary records verification/metrics/bootstrap wall and CPU, explicitly excluding its final JSON write. Contract distinguishes aggregate, nested and optional invocation-wrapper costs.

other_findings_and_closures.finding: Five independent fitted-seed clusters do not justify a finite-sample coverage guarantee from a nominal percentile-bootstrap/Bonferroni label.
other_findings_and_closures.closure: Registration and contract now explicitly state five clusters and nominal/approximate coverage; primary sign evidence is separated from practical anchor-relative thresholds.

validation_provenance.reviewer_performed: Static source/protocol/test review and read-only file hashing only.

nonblocking_limitations: verify_confirmation is an identity and consistency audit; it does not independently recompute every forecast/score from the frozen model. Do not describe it as a complete numerical replay.
Five-seed bootstrap uncertainty remains approximate; the review does not upgrade nominal coverage or descriptive profile gates into finite-sample certificates.
The primary result concerns a candidate-range/resolution selection change, not a new neuron class, first-passage behavior, downstream utility, runtime benefit or recovery of missing Round4 evidence.
Source identity review does not substitute for actual preparation, freeze/publication, confirmation and evidence receipts.

verdict.scope: Valid only for the five exact source hashes above and the pinned inherited source identity.
confirmation_preconditions: Successful complete preparation under the unchanged reviewed protocol and environment
Freeze binding to the reviewed registration, sources and exact prepared artifacts
Source/freeze publication and durable-evidence receipts required by the root workflow before formal confirmation
No confirmation outcomes consulted to change the registered method or acceptance rules
